construction: Twenty-four complete authored whole-character drawings selected from six 2x2 source atlases. No limb rigs, idle warps or pixel-interpolated anatomy.
registration: Uniform whole-master source density466/sourcecellheight. Neck/belt patches register horizontal placement and baseline body layout; an explicitly authored whole-figure weight-transfer curve uses annotated anatomical stance contacts, then separate airborne rise/recovery. No occupied-bounds scaling, detached-limb manipulation, or airborne-foot floor snapping.
